answer_1.quote: We evaluate WPO on instruction following benchmarks, including Alpaca Eval 2 and MT-bench.

answer_2.quote: Alpaca Eval 2 is an automated metric that measures LLMs' alignment with human preferences... The win rate is the probability that the autoevaluator prefers the evaluated model's responses. ... MT-bench ... we report results using two scoring methods. In the single answer grading approach, the auto-evaluator assigns scores from 1 to 10... In the pairwise comparison approach, the evaluator compares two responses to decide which is better.

answer_3.quote: For each instruction, the evaluated model's response and gpt-4-turbo's response are compared head-to-head using an auto-evaluator. ... In MT-bench, the auto-evaluator (gpt-4-0613) assigns scores ... and compares two responses to decide which is better.
